reason: I'm abroad and the build burns money every day, and my admin's spreadsheet is always a week behind, so seeing rows show up the same day for $35 a month is nothing to me. The 30 free documents with no card means I can test it on the site's real notas before I pay anything.
objection: Half of what the builders send is faded thermal paper or a handwritten nota from a toko bangunan in Indonesian. If it reads 150.000 as 15.000 or misses items, my admin ends up checking every row anyway and I'm paying to have two people do the same job.
would_change_my_mind: If it gets the amounts wrong on the first batch of handwritten site receipts, I'd drop it before the free 30 run out.
